question.en: What is an ongoing engineering subscription?

answer.id: Model kemitraan langganan memberikan Anda akses berkelanjutan ke seluruh kapabilitas engineering dan desain Gemilang Labs dengan biaya tetap periodik. Alih-alih merekrut tim internal dengan overhead tinggi atau membuat kontrak baru setiap kali butuh fitur, Anda dapat meminta pengerjaan produk, web platform, AI, dan sistem secara fleksibel dalam satu kemitraan terpadu.
answer.en: An engineering subscription gives you continuous access to Gemilang Labs for a fixed recurring fee. Instead of hiring expensive in-house talent or scoping a new contract every time you need something, you can continuously request digital product, web, AI, and systems work through one flexible partnership.

question.en: How does the request queue work?

answer.id: Anda memasukkan daftar tugas ke dalam dashboard Trello/Notion bersama, mengatur urutan prioritas yang paling penting, dan tim kami akan mengeksekusinya sesuai paket Anda (1 atau 2 tugas aktif sekaligus). Anda bebas mengubah prioritas atau menambahkan tugas baru kapan saja.
answer.en: You add requests to a shared queue in Trello or Notion, prioritize what matters most, and we work through them based on your plan (1 or 2 active requests at a time). You can reprioritize or add new requests anytime.

question.id: Apakah benar-benar tanpa batas permintaan (unlimited requests)?
question.en: Is there really no limit on requests?

answer.id: Ya. Anda dapat memasukkan sebanyak mungkin permintaan ke dalam backlog Anda. Batasan yang berlaku hanyalah jumlah tugas yang sedang dikerjakan secara aktif dan simultan pada saat bersamaan (1 tugas di Essential, 2 tugas di Priority).
answer.en: Yes. You can add as many requests as you want to your backlog. The only limit is how many requests are actively in progress simultaneously (1 active on Essential, 2 on Priority).

question.en: How fast will I receive updates?

answer.id: Sebagian besar tugas skala kecil hingga menengah mendapatkan pembaruan progres nyata dalam 2–4 hari kerja (atau 24–48 jam untuk paket Priority). Pekerjaan berskala besar dipecah menjadi milestone terukur sehingga Anda melihat kemajuan bertahap tanpa menunggu berminggu-minggu.
answer.en: Most small-to-medium requests receive meaningful progress within 2–4 business days (or 24–48 hours on Priority). Larger systems work is broken into modular milestones so you see continuous progress without waiting weeks.

question.id: Apa yang dihitung sebagai satu permintaan (one request)?

answer.id: Satu permintaan adalah unit kerja yang terdefinisi jelas, misalnya satu landing page baru, alur checkout, dashboard analitik, integrasi API AI, atau refaktor komponen frontend. Tugas besar dibagi menjadi sub-tugas terkelola agar rilis tetap cepat dan stabil.
answer.en: A request is a clearly defined scope of work, such as a new landing page, checkout flow, analytics dashboard, AI API integration, or frontend refactoring. Larger requests are divided into sub-milestones to keep delivery fast.

question.en: Can you sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)?

answer.id: Tentu saja. Kami sangat menghormati kerahasiaan bisnis dan intellectual property (IP) Anda. Kami siap menandatangani NDA resmi sebelum pertukaran informasi teknis dimulai. Proyek dalam mode stealth tidak akan dipublikasikan di portofolio kami tanpa izin tertulis Anda.
answer.en: Absolutely. We strictly respect your intellectual property and business confidentiality. We routinely sign standard NDAs before any technical handover. Stealth projects remain completely confidential until your official public release.

question.id: Siapa yang sesungguhnya mengerjakan proyek saya?
question.en: Who will actually engineer and design my product?

answer.id: Gemilang Labs beroperasi secara founder-led. Keterlibatan senior engineer dan lead architect hadir langsung di setiap proyek Anda. Anda berkomunikasi langsung dengan para praktisi yang membangun sistem Anda, bukan melalui lapisan account manager yang tidak memahami detail teknis.
answer.en: Gemilang Labs is founder-led. Senior engineering and architectural involvement is baked into every engagement. You work directly with senior practitioners building your software, not through bureaucratic layers of junior handoffs.

question.id: Bisakah saya menjeda (pause) atau membatalkan langganan?
question.en: Can I pause or cancel my subscription?

answer.id: Bisa. Paket langganan standar dapat dibatalkan sebelum siklus penagihan berikutnya tanpa penalti. Jika pekerjaan sedang sedikit, sisa hari langganan dapat Anda pause dan dilanjutkan kembali saat Anda siap meluncurkan sprint baru.
answer.en: Yes. Subscriptions can be cancelled anytime before the next billing cycle. Unused subscription days can also be paused and resumed later when your product priorities pick back up.
